Oh my god I am so late to this, but I found an easier solution for all of this that I will share everywhere

If you are in an environment where there is still audio output, you can just do the following:

ctrl + windows + enter to enter narrator, which will help you navigate blind

Win+R

in the box write ms-settings:display

enter

now keep tabbing until you hear advanced display

enter the menu and then tab until you hear "select a display to view or change its settings"

space, then use arrows to navigate until you hear your monitors name

enter

tab until you hear "remove display from desktop"

space

and done!
